title: Logistics Operations Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 TalentFlow Consulting Private Limited is a professional services firm focused on connecting organizations with skilled talent and providing end\-to\-end workforce solutions. The company works across multiple industries, helping clients optimize their operations and build high\-performing teams. TalentFlow emphasizes ethical practices, transparent communication, and long\-term partnerships with both clients and professionals. Team members can expect a collaborative environment with opportunities to contribute to operational excellence and process improvement. The organization values adaptability, problem\-solving, and a commitment to quality service delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Logistics Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City, responsible for overseeing daily logistics and supply chain operations. This role includes managing inventory levels, coordinating inbound and outbound shipments, and ensuring timely delivery of goods and materials. The Logistics Manager will work closely with procurement, warehousing, and customer service teams to streamline processes, control costs, and maintain accurate records. Typical tasks involve monitoring logistics performance, resolving delivery issues, optimizing routes, and ensuring compliance with company policies and relevant regulations. The role also requires preparing regular reports, using logistics and inventory management systems, and continuously improving workflows to support business objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Logistics Management and Supply Chain Management, with the ability to plan, execute, and optimize end\-to\-end operations.
* Practical experience in Inventory Management and Procurement, including maintaining stock accuracy and coordinating with suppliers.
* Proficiency in Customer Service within a logistics context, ensuring timely communication, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction.
* Ability to use logistics, inventory, and ERP software tools, with solid skills in data analysis and reporting using spreadsheets or similar applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant certifications are an advantage.
* Strong organizational, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with attention to detail and a focus on process improvement.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and guide operational staff, manage workload priorities, and meet deadlines under pressure.

title: Admissions Manager
company: Guide to Heights - Certified Study Abroad Consultants
description:
**About Guide to Heights** 




 Guide to Heights is a study abroad consultancy headquartered in Kochi, with offices in Sharjah (UAE) and Melbourne (Australia). We are QEAC certified and British Council registered, and we help students and families from Kerala and the GCC get into universities in Australia, the UK, New Zealand, Ireland and Germany. Our focus is honest, career\-focused guidance: the right course, a sound visa pathway, and support until the student is settled abroad.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for an experienced Counsellor and Admissions Manager to join our Kochi office. You will own each student's journey end to end, from the first counselling session to visa approval and course commencement. You'll work closely with students, parents, university partners and our internal team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Counsel students and parents on course, university and destination selection based on academic profile, budget and career goals
* Manage the complete admissions process, including applications, offer letters, documentation, and CoE/CAS
* Guide students through student visa applications, especially the Australia Student Visa (Subclass 500\) and Genuine Student (GS) requirements
* Review and support SOPs, GS statements and scholarship applications
* Coordinate with universities, B2B partners and aggregators to move applications forward
* Communicate regularly with parents by phone, WhatsApp and email
* Keep follow\-ups and student records up to date in the CRM
* Deliver a high\-quality student experience and collect reviews and testimonials from satisfied students
* Take part in team training, meetings, webinars and pre\-departure sessions


- 


**What We're Looking For** 



* 2\+ years of experience in study abroad counselling or admissions (Australia and/or UK experience strongly preferred)
* Solid working knowledge of Australian, NZ and UK admission processes and student visa requirements
* Excellent spoken and written English and Malayalam
* Clear, professional email writing and quick responsiveness
* Strong attention to detail in documentation
* Comfortable using CRM tools, Google Workspace/Office and WhatsApp for business communication
* A student\-first attitude: honest advice over hard selling
* A graduate degree in any discipline (a degree or study experience abroad is a plus)



  





**Work Details** 



* Full\-time, on\-site at our Kakkanad office (Infopark Express Highway, Kochi)
* Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays during peak intakes
* Laptop and mobile phone provided



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with an established, certified consultancy that has international offices
* Direct mentorship from the founder, a Deakin University alumnus with more than 10 years in international education
* Real ownership of student outcomes in a growing team

 Delight International Facilities Management (DIFM) is a leading total facilities management company headquartered in Abu Dhabi with a strong presence in Dubai and across the UAE. Established in 1989, DIFM has over 37 years of experience delivering integrated FM services that enhance property value, safety, and operational efficiency for diverse sectors, including residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, and government. The company manages a large workforce of trained professionals and has delivered over a million solutions to more than 1,000 clients. Its services span hard and soft facilities management, specialist services, fit\-out and renovation, maintenance programs, and energy and sustainability management. DIFM’s ISO certifications and ESG\-aligned values of Excellence, Sustainability, Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, Safety, and Accountability highlight its commitment to quality, client satisfaction, and responsible operations.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Administrative Officer is a full\-time, remote role responsible for providing day\-to\-day HR administrative support to ensure smooth and compliant people operations. This role maintains employee records, prepares HR documentation, and supports the implementation of HR policies and procedures. The officer coordinates onboarding and offboarding processes, assists with employee queries, and supports performance management and attendance tracking. They help organize HR\-related communications, assist in maintaining compliance with labor and employment regulations, and collaborate with HR management to support employee relations activities. The role also involves generating HR reports, updating HR systems, and supporting HR projects and initiatives as needed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • HR Business Partner Strategy and Implementation
 



 • Talent Acquisition: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment support with Talent Team.
 



 • Performance Management: Administer performance appraisal cycles, KPI frameworks and structured review processes.
 



 • Learning and Development: Identify training needs in coordination with department heads
 



 • Grievance Management: Handle employee grievances through structured, confidential resolution processes.
 



 • Labour Law and HR Regulations: Ensure HR practices comply with applicable labour law and statutory requirements.
 



 • Payroll, Leave and HR Operations: Support payroll inputs, leave administration and attendance management.
 



 • HR Budgeting and Analytics: Contribute to HR budget planning, monitoring and cost control. Prepare HR metrics, dashboards and reports to support management decision\-making. Analyse workforce data to identify trends and improvement areas
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA in Human Resources is mandatory
* 7 to 10 years of progressive HR experience with demonstrated exposure across HR business partnering, talent acquisition, performance management, learning and development, grievance management, labour law and regulations, payroll and HR operations, and HR budgeting and analytics
* Experience supporting HR functions across multiple entities or business units is preferred



 • Willingness to travel between Kochi and other DIG offices as required.

title: Senior Academic Counselor
description:
**Job Title: Senior Academic Counselor** 




**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a high\-performing Senior Academic Counselor to drive our enrollment funnel and mentor our junior team. This is a pivotal, hybrid role requiring a combination of advanced consultative sales mastery (Deep Counseling) and leadership capabilities (Coaching, QA, and Funnel Ownership). You will handle complex, high\-stakes enrollments, enforce strict operational boundaries, and provide data\-driven insights to the Hub Manager/Founder.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Honest Intake \& Deep Counseling:**
* **The 45\-Minute Session:** 
 Run comprehensive counseling sessions at the center (ideally with a parent present). Explain the course architecture and present the reality of the program honestly, explicitly including the demanding aspects that put people off.
* **Qualify \& Firmly Disqualify:** 
 Record exactly why a lead is not a fit. Turn away prospects who require classroom teaching or cannot commit to six days a week—kindly, but firmly.
* **Protect the Schedule:** 
 Enforce strict intake rules. Cohorts open every Monday. Never promise a start date that is not a Monday, a gate that is not a Thursday or Friday, or a guaranteed job.
* **Closing \& Financial Administration:**
* **Secure Enrollments:**

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Proficio Therapy Services provides pediatric ABA, speech, and occupational therapy designed to support children and families through individualized, compassionate care. Serving communities in California and Utah, including South Jordan, the team helps children build communication, social, behavioral, and daily living skills in a supportive environment. The organization partners closely with families, celebrates progress, and strives to create meaningful outcomes for every child. Through specialized programs such as AGES Learning Solutions (ABA services) and Child’s Play (pediatric occupational therapy), Proficio offers comprehensive support tailored to each child’s needs. Committed to expanding access to quality pediatric therapy, Proficio works to make a positive impact locally and globally.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Credentialing Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Thane. This role is responsible for managing provider credentialing processes, including collecting, verifying, and updating practitioner information for insurance panels, hospitals, and regulatory bodies. The specialist coordinates with internal teams and external organizations to ensure timely submission of applications and re\-credentialing, maintains accurate records in credentialing databases, and monitors expiration dates for licenses, certifications, and contracts. Day\-to\-day tasks include reviewing documentation for completeness, resolving credentialing discrepancies, responding to provider and payer inquiries, and supporting compliance with organizational and regulatory standards. The person in this role collaborates with clinical and administrative staff to support smooth onboarding of new providers and continuity of care for clients.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties:** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end provider credentialing and recredentialing process for physicians, therapists, BCBAs, SLPs, OTs and other healthcare professionals.
* Prepare, submit, and track credentialing applications with commercial insurance payers, Medicare, Medicaid, and other healthcare networks.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of provider enrollment, revalidation, and recredentialing applications.
* Maintain accurate provider records, licenses, certifications, malpractice insurance, DEA registrations, NPI information, and other required documentation.
* Monitor credentialing expiration dates and proactively initiate renewal activities to prevent disruptions in provider participation and billing.
* Follow up with insurance payers, credentialing organizations, and regulatory agencies regarding application status and pending requirements.
* Maintain and update provider information within credentialing databases, CAQH, payer portals, and internal systems.
* Coordinate with providers and internal teams to obtain required documentation and resolve credentialing\-related issues.
* Track credentialing turnaround times and maintain detailed records of application submissions, approvals, denials, and expirations.
* Ensure compliance with payer requirements, CMS regulations, NCQA standards, and organizational policies.
* Support provider onboarding by facilitating timely credentialing and enrollment processes.
* Investigate and resolve credentialing discrepancies, application rejections, and enrollment delays.
* Assist with audits and compliance reviews by maintaining accurate and organized credentialing documentation.
* Generate credentialing status reports, provider enrollment reports, and operational metrics for leadership review.
* Develop and maintain credentialing workflows, SOPs, and process documentation.
* Collaborate with Revenue Cycle Management, Human Resources, Compliance, Clinical Operations, and Provider Relations teams to ensure smooth provider onboarding and credentialing processes.
* Stay current with changes in payer requirements, credentialing regulations, provider enrollment guidelines, and industry best practices.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* 2–15 years of experience in US Healthcare Credentialing, Provider Enrollment, or Medical Staff Services.
* Strong knowledge of provider credentialing, recredentialing, payer enrollment, and provider data management processes.
* Experience working with commercial insurance payers, Medicare, Medicaid, and CAQH.
* Familiarity with NCQA standards, CMS regulations, and healthcare credentialing best practices.
* Experience managing provider licenses, certifications, malpractice insurance, and regulatory documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple credentialing applications simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, credentialing software, and payer portals.
* Experience supporting behavioral health, ABA, therapy, or multi\-specialty healthcare organizations is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as CPCS (Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist) or CPMSM are an advantage but not required.



  





**Work Schedule:** 




  




* Full\-Time – Onsite (Kochi)
* Night Shift to support US operations and payer working hours.
* Ability to collaborate with US\-based teams and accommodate operational requirements as needed.



  





**Work Environment:** 




  




* Fast\-paced healthcare revenue cycle environment supporting ABA services.
* Regular interaction with insurance payers, healthcare providers, licensing boards, and internal stakeholders.
* Opportunity to work closely with Revenue Cycle Management, Compliance, Clinical Operations, and Provider Relations teams.
* Collaborative work environment requiring strong attention to detail and adherence to deadlines.



  





**Compensation \& Benefits:** 




  




* Salary: 38000 \- 45000
* Annual Performance Bonus.
* Medical Insurance Coverage.
* Paid time off.
* Opportunity to lead and scale revenue cycle operations within a rapidly growing international healthcare organization.

 MOULDING

 Responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining injection moulding processes to achieve production targets for quality, productivity, cost, and delivery. The role supports New Product Introduction (NPI), process validation, troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and customer requirements while ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards.

* Develop, establish, and optimize injection moulding processes for new and existing products.

* Support new mould trials, first\-off approvals, and production readiness.
* Participate in new product introduction (NPI) activities from RFQ through mass production.

* Provide technical support to production teams for process\-related issues.

* Improve cycle time, productivity, machine utilization, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Minimize process scrap and improve First Pass Yield (FPY).

* PFMEA
* Process Flow Diagram (PFD)
* Control Plan
* Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Process Validation Reports
* Trial Reports
* Work Instructions

* Support PPAP, APQP, and engineering change implementation.

* Coordinate with Tool Room, Quality, Maintenance, Production, Planning, and NPI teams.
* Support mould modifications and engineering changes.
* Conduct operator and technician training on process standards and best practices.

* Ensure adherence to EHS policies and safe moulding practices.
* Maintain compliance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and company standards.

**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Injection Moulding Process Optimization
* Scientific Moulding Techniques
* Process Validation \& Qualification
* NPI \& Production Support
* PFMEA, Control Plan \& PPAP
* Root Cause Analysis (8D, 5 Why)
* OEE \& Productivity Improvement
* Lean Manufacturing \& Kaizen
* AutoCAD / Creo
* ERP Systems (SAP/QAD/Oracle)
* MS Office
* Strong Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Polymer, Production, or Plastics Engineering
 **.**



**Experience** 




**Senior Process Engineer** 



* 5–8 years of experience in Injection Moulding Process Engineering in a manufacturing environment.

Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!

* We are looking for a Manager to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Manager within the Actuarial AXIS modelling team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

**On engagements, you will:**
* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**
* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, North America, Latin America, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Africa, UK and European Countries
* Overall 8\+ to 15 years of actuarial experience with 6\+ years of AXIS modeling experience or in AXIS valuation / reporting / pricing experience in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good understanding of US/ Canada product lines and regulations; hands\-on IFRS17 or LDTI implementation experience (optional)
* Project management experience and ability to handle teams and multiple stakeholders
* Advance modelling experience in AXIS software
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Strong presentation and documentation skills
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging, and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary with at least 8\+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, IFRS17 or LDTI)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognised insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**

 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. title: Learning and Change Transformation -Senior Consultant -Arabic
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**ROLE : Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change**
**Experience** 
 : 7–9 years, including substantial client\-facing L\&D consulting experience
   

  

**Capability profile :** 
 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability
   

  

**Engagement model** 
 : Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery
   

  

**Travel :** 
 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities. One of the two Senior Consultant vacancies will require demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**
* Own one or more learning and change workstreams across scope, quality, schedule, effort, dependencies, risks and client communication.
* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**
* Independently draft solution approaches, proposal narratives, methodologies, workplans, staffing models, delivery plans, assumptions, risks and effort estimates.
* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting judgement: structures ambiguous problems, forms hypotheses, makes evidence\-based recommendations and knows when to escalate.
* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.


**Preferred**
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Captivate or comparable content tools.
* Experience on digital transformation, ERP, AI adoption or workforce transformation programmes


**ARABIC LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT**
**For the Arabic\-designated Senior Consultant vacancy:** 
 business\-level Arabic in reading, writing and speaking is mandatory. The candidate must be able to review proposal content, participate in client discussions, support workshops and interpret business context accurately. Native nationality or ethnic origin is not a requirement.
   

  

* Assessment should include a role\-relevant Arabic writing exercise, proposal review, a short client conversation and workshop facilitation simulation.
* Language capability should be evaluated consistently against job\-relevant performance, not nationality or background.


**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within Agreed Development Plan**
* PROSCI or an equivalent recognised change management certification.
* Design thinking / human\-centred design / workshop facilitation credential or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential.
* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* CCMP.
* Kirkpatrick learning evaluation credential.
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry practitioner accreditation.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe certification.
* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.
* Recognised business Arabic proficiency evidence, supplemented by practical assessment.


**WAYS OF WORKING**
**INITIAL RAMP\-UP**
* 50% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits and proposal support.
* 10% capability building.
* 10% internal initiatives


**ONCE STAFFED ON A BILLABLE ENGAGEMENT**
* 70% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits, proposal support and agreed capability contribution.
* Allocation remains subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.


**INDICATIVE SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Delivery**
* Own at least one significant learning or change workstream and achieve agreed scope, quality, schedule and client\-feedback expectations.
* Workplan, quality reviews and client feedback.


**Pursuits**
* Make material contributions to priority MENA proposals, including independent ownership of assigned solution and delivery sections.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. **Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**

**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.

**Pursuits, proposals and market support**

* Use business\-level Arabic capability, where required, to review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.

* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.

title: Associate III - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient AWS Cloud Engineer with 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, production support, and incident management. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and application issues while ensuring high availability, reliability, and security of cloud environments. This role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams to support, optimize, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure and operational excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, deploy, manage, and support AWS cloud infrastructure in production environments.
* Monitor system availability, performance, and security to ensure reliable service delivery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and application\-related issues across AWS environments.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Manage and support containerized workloads using Amazon ECS and Docker.
* Configure and maintain AWS networking components including VPC, Route 53, Load Balancers, Security Groups, and Network ACLs.
* Support CI/CD deployments and collaborate with development teams for application releases.
* Implement infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools where applicable.
* Monitor infrastructure using CloudWatch and other enterprise monitoring solutions.
* Ensure adherence to cloud security best practices, compliance standards, and operational procedures.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in production support activities, incident response, maintenance windows, and on\-call rotations as required.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing AWS cloud environments.
* Strong experience supporting production workloads in AWS.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of cloud networking concepts and Linux system administration.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.


**Skills**
 AWS, AWS CloudFormation, AWS Security Groups, Amazon CloudWatch, Access Control Lists, Amazon ECS, Amazon Route 53, Amazon VPC, CI/CD, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Security

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**The Role** 




 As a Platform Engineer in the Data \& Analytics team, you’ll sit at the vital intersection between software engineering and infrastructure. Your mission is to ensurethat the systemswe build are not only functional, but also resilient, observable, performant, and production ready.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, and the central infrastructure team to design and support the environments, tooling, and operational practicesthat power our data platform.From CI/CD pipelines to database performance tuning, observability, and scaling strategy — you’ll be the expert who helps us build mechanical sympathy between our code and the systems it runs on.
 



 This is a hands\-on, enablingrole ideal for someone who loves helpingteams ship great software safelyand reliably.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipelines for the Data Platform, supporting fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Enhance observability across services, pipelines, and data flows, supporting logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
* Monitor and optimize databaseperformance, availability, and access patterns.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teamsto ensure HA, disaster recovery, and scaling strategies are in place and well understood.
* Partner with engineers to define best practices for environment management, secrets, configuration, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Support the team in diagnosing and resolving production issues and in building systemsthat are easier to debug and maintain.
* Identify and reduce operational friction, creating tools or automations where needed to improve reliability and developer velocity.



  





  





 Essential Criteria
 



  




* Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application performance tooling.
* Practical knowledge of observability stacks— including metrics,logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Hands\-on experience with databases(e.g. PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or cloud\-native DBs), including monitoring and tuning.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (preferably AWS), containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* A collaborative mindset, able to work across engineering and infrastructure teamsto solve shared problems.
* Passion for enabling others,improving developer experience, and building reliablesystems.



  





  





 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience supporting data pipelines, analytics platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
* Familiarity with data management frameworks (e.g. AWS Glue, Temporal) and performance profiling in data\-intensive environments.
* Exposure to monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana,Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
* Understanding of security best practices relatedto data platforms, secrets management, and access control.
* Knowledge of container orchestration and serverless deployment patterns (e.g. ECS, Fargate, Lambda).



  





  





 What We Offer
 


* A unique opportunity to shape the operational backboneof our company’s data platform.
* A collaborative engineering culturewhere operational excellence is valued and supported.
* The freedom to improvehow things are built, deployed,and run with real impact.
* A close partnership with experienced engineersand infrastructure specialists.
* A modern, cloud\-native stackand a platform that’s scalingrapidly.

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The analyst will work closely with design engineers, product development teams, IT professionals, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support engineering processes. Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.
* Support engineering teams in the effective use of engineering systems, business applications, and product data management processes.
* Assist in analysing engineering and product data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and third\-party vendors to gather requirements, support projects, and resolve technical issues.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, testing activities, and implementation of process improvements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, validation tools, and business intelligence outputs that support engineering operations.
* Assist with administration and routine maintenance activities for Windows Server environments supporting engineering applications.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, user guides, process documentation, test reports, release notes, and technical specifications.
* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.
* The successful candidate will work under guidance of Senior Analyst, who will oversee their workload and scheduling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in information systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related subject is preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience supporting business applications, enterprise systems, engineering systems, or technical software platforms, with hands\-on experience using SQL for reporting, data analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data structures, and relationships between enterprise systems.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as PLM, ERP, Product Data Management (PDM), Document Management, CAD, or similar engineering systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, JSON, XML, XSLT, ODBC databases, and Web Services is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, application hosting platforms, and system administration concepts.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment is desirable.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: EDI Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The EDI Support Analyst will be responsible for supporting NOV’s electronic data interchange (EDI) and business\-to\-business (B2B) integrations within the Shared Services organization. This position focuses on production support, customer onboarding, and project coordination to ensure stable and efficient data exchange between NOV and its trading partners. The role requires a balance of technical acumen, communication skills, and process discipline to drive seamless integration, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across NOV’s EDI/B2B landscape.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide day\-to\-day production support for EDI/B2B transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and issue resolution.
* Monitor and troubleshoot EDI transaction failures and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve them promptly.
* Support onboarding of new customers and suppliers to NOV’s EDI/B2B platforms.
* Partner with business users and ERP technical teams to analyze integration requirements and implement new EDI/B2B connections.
* Coordinate testing, documentation, and deployment of EDI/B2B enhancements or projects.
* Maintain transaction performance reports and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability and data quality.
* Document and maintain partner profiles and process flows.
* Collaborate with Shared Services, Operations, and external trading partners to ensure alignment in business processes and system capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in EDI/B2B integration, including production support and project coordination.
* Working knowledge of EDI standards (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML) and related transaction sets.
* Familiarity with integration of middleware tools (e.g., BizTalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with supply chain transactions like RFQ/Quote/PO/SO/Ship Notice/Invoice etc.
* Experience managing incident tickets and change requests (Jira, or similar).
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with customer/vendor onboarding and production support in a supply chain environment.
* Exposure to Shared Services or global IT support functions.
* Understanding of ERP integrations, preferably Oracle PO/SO/Ship/Invoice modules.

title: Tech S and T-Infra Automation Consultant-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

**Job Description**
**Job Title Change Management Specialist**
**Function: (Category for Job Posting)**
**Job Summary:**
 The Service Management (SM) Change Management Specialist role is responsible for monitoring the ongoing ‘wellnesses of Information Technology (IT) Change Management processes, procedures and policies. The role drives the analytical review of the relevant processes, scheduled reporting and other metrics to confirm that the end\-to\-end processes are operating in a Business as Usual (BAU) mode or to identify exceptions to same. The role leads discussions with Change Lead and /or business leaders on identified process exceptions and recommends potential solutions to rectify breaks in a specific process. The role requires a solid working knowledge of and certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework as part of the role’s core mandate to drive best practices in the alignment of business needs to IT capabilities. The role acts as thought leader in the use of the Service Management tool as trainer to the user population and are advanced users of its monitoring capabilities for IT’s processes. The role may have management responsibility for the Process Analysts who provide the process analytics and is generally guided by the Change Process Lead.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Designs, assesses and delivers the performance analysis of all day\-to\-day Change process under its remit to determine the stability of local, area, global IT applications and the effectiveness of their processes, procedures and policies. Examines Critical Success Factors (CSF), Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and other key metrics produced on a daily, weekly or monthly basis as a critical component of the analysis.
* Defines and coordinates senior level meetings inclusive of monthly services reviews and more frequent meetings to identify root cause of change failures with intent to improve production stability. Identifies change caused outages in co\-ordination with Incident Management and drives input into Continuous Service Improvement and/or Risk Registers.
* Engages with Incident, Problem, Release Management and consults in major outage discussions/meetings as a thought leader on current processes and adds valued insight across senior members of the organization on efforts to restore overall services.
* Actively participates and works with lead/ other stakeholders in design, build and maintenance of CMDB
* Assumes and drives responsibility for escalation actions, as needed, when it is observed that the appropriate IT process is not being adhered to.
* Organizes and leads appropriate post mortem activities with senior members of the organization on Change processes not executed appropriately and drives follow through on actions identified as a result.
* Drives adherence to NewCo build’s compliance standards of IT processes and procedures wherever applicable. Develops and directs practices to improve compliance mandates and/or identifies and implements improvements in process/procedures to support existing compliance directives.
* Leads and coordinates meetings with all levels of the organization directly or under guidance of Lead to review existing KPIs and other metrics aligned to a specific process to drive continued improvements and production stability and/or end user satisfaction. Identifies \& assesses risks, forecasts challenges and opportunities and provides related recommendations including the proposed creation of new KPIs and other modifications based on analysis.
* Engages with vendors for getting root cause and solution of the issues as required.
* Researches, recommends, develops, and implements updates and amendments to the Service Management tool to reflect identified enhancements or changes to process and procedures. Partners with the Quality Management and Automation team to develop and implement necessary modifications to the tool so that it reflects the latest services, procedures and activities.
* Designs and develops training materials, communiques and related documentation to inform and train IT users in the Change process and tool and to embed the process as part of the required business knowledge of the IT organization.
* Ascertains best practices in aligning business needs to an IT organization by maintaining a strong knowledge of industry standards in process management through formal certification and training in the ITIL framework and a knowledge of current and proposed future state of IT processes and procedures
* A good knowledge in dashboards and reporting
* Willingness to work on required automation initiatives and understanding of the same will be added advantage
* Should be willing to work during weekends and in rotational shifts


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires a strong analytical acumen and solution orientation to understand the nuances of Change Management process across cultures and geographic regions as well as within the IT organization. The role additionally requires consultative questioning and influence management skills as well as solid business knowledge of IT services and capabilities to identify the source of a service break and recommend viable solutions that will properly and efficiently resume service delivery.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to engage, as a thought leader, senior executives of the firm, in cross business discussions within a matrixed, geographically dispersed organization and to build a solid network of peers and others of influence. Uses these relationships to connect colleagues, challenge insightfully to improve processes and propose credible options
* Well defined consultative skills to conduct effective questioning , hone in on key issues to formulate ideas and materials as well as present those ideas clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization including senior and/or executive management
* Advanced oral, presentation and written communication skills in the English language. Exhibits the ability to adapt communication style to the style of others, developing rapport and staying calm under pressure and to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Has an active learning acumen about the application/infrastructure delivery and related operations organizations to engage team members in issues resolution with confidence and credibility
* Strong analytical and problem solving ability to escalate and negotiate complex and conflicting issues in IT technical investigations, handle multiple and shifting priorities across a broad spectrum of operating environments and to drive solutions that are both financially sound and operationally feasible.
* Excellent Microsoft Office experience, predominantly Excel, Visio and PowerPoint. Strong skills in knowledge sharing tools such as SharePoint
* Assists the Change Management Process Lead with resolving team conflicts, providing peer mentoring, and with the implementation \& communication of difficult decisions; is able to manage team or project by delegating work effectively and using appropriate resources
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and also during weekends


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 Contingent on location, the role can be an individual contributor or may manage Change Management Analysts. As manager, the role requires seasoned management skills inclusive of recommending staff for hire to SM / Change Management Lead, setting objectives aligned to those for the lead and SM as a whole, reviewing accomplishments, coaching for success and counselling for improvement. Assigned staff may be remote based and/or in a work from home setting that will require distance management skills across locations, cultures and time zones. The role itself is generally guided by the Change Management Lead
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
 The role may also require the periodic allocation of additional time on the job to support multiple demands and escalating issues.
   

  

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experience
   

  

**Experience:**
 Approximately 8 to 10 years of experience in an Operational/Service Management role with at least 3\-5 years in Change Management.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 ITIL v2 or v3 Foundations training, or higher level of ITIL Certification as may be required
